root_cause.text: The bonding receive validation path in `bond_rcv_validate()` processed IPv6 NS/NA packets without checking whether the IPv6 subsystem was actually enabled, allowing `bond_validate_na()` → `bond_has_this_ip6()` → `ipv6_chk_addr()` to dereference the uninitialized neighbor discovery table `nd_tbl` when booted with `ipv6.disable=1`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that with `ipv6.disable=1`, `inet6_init()` exits before `ndisc_init()` initializes `nd_tbl`, and the patch fixes this by changing `} else if (is_ipv6) {` to `} else if (is_ipv6 && likely(ipv6_mod_enabled())) {`, explicitly blocking the crash path to `ipv6_chk_addr()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Guard IPv6 bond receive handling so neighbor advertisement processing runs only when IPv6 is enabled.
intent_record.what: The IPv6 receive branch in bond_rcv_validate() was changed from checking only is_ipv6 to checking both is_ipv6 and likely(ipv6_mod_enabled()) before calling bond_na_rcv().
intent_record.how: At runtime, IPv6 bonding packet validation will now invoke the IPv6-specific neighbor advertisement receive handler only when the packet is IPv6 and the IPv6 module is enabled, avoiding execution of IPv6 handling logic when IPv6 support is disabled.

grouping_result.intent: Guard IPv6 bond receive handling so neighbor advertisement processing runs only when IPv6 is enabled.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds a guard so IPv6 bond receive/NA validation only runs when IPv6 is enabled, preventing the IPv6 validation path from reaching ipv6_chk_addr() with IPv6 disabled.

candidates.rationale: This dispatches IPv6 neighbor advertisement/solicitation receive handling solely based on CONFIG_IPV6 and packet type, without verifying that IPv6 is enabled at runtime. That allows the later path into bond_validate_na()/ipv6_chk_addr() to run when ipv6.disable=1 and dereference uninitialized IPv6 neighbor state.
This branch condition routes IPv6 packets into bond NA handling without any runtime check for IPv6 subsystem availability, which is the missing guard described in the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement dispatches IPv6 neighbor advertisement/solicitation receive processing without verifying that the IPv6 subsystem is enabled at runtime. That allows the call chain into bond_validate_na() and ultimately ipv6_chk_addr() when ipv6.disable=1, triggering dereference of uninitialized IPv6 neighbor discovery state.

This branch condition selects the IPv6 receive-validation path based only on packet classification, with no runtime guard for IPv6 being disabled. It is the control-flow gate that permits execution of the vulnerable bond_na_rcv() path under ipv6.disable=1.

There is no check such as `ipv6_mod_enabled()` or equivalent before processing received IPv6 NS/NA packets. Therefore the bug is present, and the fix is not yet included.
